title: "Pemodelan ARIMA Harga Cabai"
author: "Lutfiatun Nisa"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

# 1. Persiapan Package

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
packages <- c("forecast", "tseries", "ggplot2", "xts")

for (pkg in packages) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}
```

# 2. Memuat Data

```{r load-data}
data <- read.csv(
  "data_fia_cabai.csv",
  sep = ";",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

head(data)
str(data)
```

# 3. Preprocessing Data

```{r preprocessing}
data$Tanggal <- as.Date(data$Tanggal, format = "%d/%m/%Y")

data$Harga <- gsub(",", ".", data$Harga)
data$Harga <- as.numeric(data$Harga)

data <- data[order(data$Tanggal), ]

ts_harga <- ts(data$Harga, frequency = 7)

head(data)
```

# 4. Plot Deret Waktu

```{r plot-original}
plot(
  ts_harga,
  main = "Plot Deret Waktu Harga Cabai",
  ylab = "Harga",
  xlab = "Waktu / Periode",
  col = "blue",
  lwd = 2
)
```

# 5. Uji Stasioneritas ADF

```{r adf-test}
adf_test <- adf.test(ts_harga)
print(adf_test)
```

# 6. Differencing

```{r differencing}
d_diff <- 0

if (adf_test$p.value > 0.05) {
  message("Data tidak stasioner, melakukan differencing...")

  ts_diff <- diff(ts_harga, differences = 1)
  d_diff <- 1

  adf_diff <- adf.test(ts_diff)
  print(adf_diff)

} else {
  message("Data sudah stasioner.")
  ts_diff <- ts_harga
}

cat("Orde differencing (d) yang digunakan:", d_diff, "\n")
```

# 7. ACF dan PACF Data Stasioner

```{r acf-pacf}
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

Acf(
  ts_diff,
  main = "ACF Differencing Harga Cabai"
)

Pacf(
  ts_diff,
  main = "PACF Differencing Harga Cabai"
)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

# 8. Pemodelan ARIMA

```{r arima-model}
model_arima <- auto.arima(
  ts_harga,
  seasonal = TRUE,
  stepwise = FALSE,
  approximation = FALSE
)

model_arima
```

# 9. Orde dan Ringkasan Model ARIMA

```{r model-summary}
arima_order <- arimaorder(model_arima)

cat("Model ARIMA terpilih:\n")
cat(
  "ARIMA(",
  arima_order[1], ",",
  arima_order[2], ",",
  arima_order[3],
  ")\n",
  sep = ""
)

summary(model_arima)
```

# 10. AIC, AICc, dan BIC

```{r model-criteria}
model_criteria <- data.frame(
  Model = paste0(
    "ARIMA(",
    arima_order[1], ",",
    arima_order[2], ",",
    arima_order[3],
    ")"
  ),
  AIC = AIC(model_arima),
  AICc = model_arima$aicc,
  BIC = BIC(model_arima)
)

model_criteria
```

# 11. Diagnostik Residual

```{r residual-diagnostics}
checkresiduals(model_arima)
```

## Uji Ljung-Box

```{r ljung-box}
residual_test <- Box.test(
  residuals(model_arima),
  lag = 10,
  type = "Ljung-Box",
  fitdf = length(coef(model_arima))
)

print(residual_test)
```

# 12. Peramalan

```{r forecasting}
forecast_result <- forecast(
  model_arima,
  h = 10
)

print(forecast_result)
```

## Plot Hasil Peramalan

```{r forecast-plot}
plot(
  forecast_result,
  main = "Hasil Peramalan ARIMA untuk Harga Cabai",
  ylab = "Harga",
  xlab = "Waktu"
)
```

# 13. Menghitung MAPE

```{r mape}
actual <- as.numeric(ts_harga)
fitted_value <- as.numeric(fitted(model_arima))

valid <- is.finite(actual) &
  is.finite(fitted_value) &
  actual != 0

mape <- mean(
  abs(
    (actual[valid] - fitted_value[valid]) /
      actual[valid]
  )
) * 100

cat("MAPE =", round(mape, 2), "%\n")
```

# 14. Ringkasan Hasil Pemodelan

```{r final-summary}
cat("========================================\n")
cat("RINGKASAN PEMODELAN ARIMA\n")
cat("========================================\n")

cat(
  "Model terpilih : ARIMA(",
  arima_order[1], ",",
  arima_order[2], ",",
  arima_order[3],
  ")\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat("AIC  :", round(AIC(model_arima), 4), "\n")
cat("AICc :", round(model_arima$aicc, 4), "\n")
cat("BIC  :", round(BIC(model_arima), 4), "\n")
cat("MAPE :", round(mape, 2), "%\n")
cat(
  "Ljung-Box p-value :",
  round(residual_test$p.value, 4),
  "\n"
)
```

# 15. Kesimpulan

```{r conclusion, results='asis'}
cat(
  "Berdasarkan tahapan pemodelan ARIMA, data harga cabai terlebih dahulu dilakukan pemeriksaan stasioneritas menggunakan uji Augmented Dickey-Fuller (ADF). ",
  "Apabila data belum stasioner, dilakukan differencing untuk memperoleh data yang stasioner. ",
  "Selanjutnya ACF dan PACF digunakan sebagai bagian dari identifikasi model. ",
  "Pemilihan model ARIMA dilakukan menggunakan auto.arima() dengan mempertimbangkan kriteria informasi model. ",
  "Model yang terpilih kemudian diperiksa melalui diagnostik residual dan uji Ljung-Box. ",
  "Setelah model memenuhi pemeriksaan diagnostik, model digunakan untuk melakukan peramalan harga cabai."
)
```

# 16. Selesai

```{r finish}
cat("Pemodelan ARIMA selesai dilakukan.\n")
```
